(() => { window.__spike = {}; const t0 = performance.now(); const now = () => +((performance.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(2); async function run(name, url, abortAt) { const rec = window.__spike[name] = {chunks: []}; const ctl = new AbortController(); if (abortAt) setTimeout(() => { rec.aborted = now(); ctl.abort(); }, abortAt * 1000); try { const res = await fetch(url, {signal: ctl.signal}); rec.status = res.status; const reader = res.body.getReader(); const dec = new TextDecoder(); for (;;) { const {done, value} = await reader.read(); if (done) { rec.done = now(); break; } rec.chunks.push([now(), dec.decode(value).trim().split('\n').at(-1)]); } } catch (e) { rec.error = [now(), e.name, e.message]; } } run('gap', '/spike/stream?run=wk-gap&total=120&gap_at=25&gap=70'); run('gap50', '/spike/stream?run=wk-gap50&total=90&gap_at=20&gap=50'); run('abort', '/spike/stream?run=wk-abort&total=40&gap=0', 10); return 'started'; })()
